newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index drops 1.29 pct in mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index drops 1.29 pct in mid-session.

text.p: The Philippine share index fell 1.29 percent at the mid-session on Thursday triggered by PLDT's drop in New York and lingering concerns over the property sector, traders said.
"The market was weak, taking its cue from PLDT. And there is still concern about the property sector and its effect on banks," said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Dharmala Securities.
At the mid-session the index was 38.26 points down at 2,922.71.
